definitions.gloss: serving a prison sentence; imprisonment; doing time
definitions.explanation: The act of serving time in prison as punishment for a crime. A formal term commonly used in news and legal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五年間|ごねんかん}{服役|ふくえき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He served five years in prison.

examples.japanese: {服役|ふくえき}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧{受刑者|じゅけいしゃ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some inmates obtain qualifications while serving their sentences.

examples.japanese: {服役|ふくえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{社会|しゃかい}{復帰|ふっき}→社会復帰：20417_shakaifukki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Reintegrating into society after serving a prison sentence is not easy.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({服役|ふくえき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). A formal word commonly seen in news reports, legal discussions, and court proceedings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {服役|ふくえき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to serve a sentence)
- {服役|ふくえき}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (while serving a sentence)
- {服役|ふくえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}える→終える：02019_oeru⟧ (to finish serving a sentence)
- {服役|ふくえき}{囚|しゅう} (prisoner; convict)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {収監|しゅうかん}: incarceration — focuses on the act of being put in prison, rather than the period of serving time
- ⟦{投獄|とうごく}→投獄：15733_tougoku⟧: imprisonment — emphasizes being thrown into prison, often with a sense of injustice
